answer: Since AI models easily compose a sonnet or render a sable, agent networks resist Sybils using hardware enclave attestation instead of behavioral tests. Each node binds its signing key to a manufacturer-signed hardware quote and chip-local monotonic counter, preventing identity cloning across virtual machines. Attackers must acquire separate attested silicon per identity, making costs spiral linearly. However, this centralizes trust in chipmakers and fails if side-channel attacks extract a root key.
